issue.title: [Bug]: Volume Levels in "Devices" view not updating when changed externally

nextActions: Review the reported behavior and build instructions; define the baseline failure before cloning or scheduling a build.
limitations: READY_TO_INVESTIGATE means metadata is sufficient to begin engineering review, not a reproduced or repaired bug.
Dependency manifests are scanned heuristically; transitive dependencies, availability of registry packages, native libraries and physical equipment are not verified.
Only explicit PR references are matched; semantically related work without links can be missed.
Runtime compatibility, contribution policy and complete reproduction steps still require engineering review.

dimensions.reason: The visible control contradicts the actual headphone/device state during ordinary use.
The report is one week old and targets current v0.6.0.
The reporter supplied exact versions and diagnostics but has not replied yet.
External volume and mute changes must update existing controls without leaving the view.
The missing refresh is visible in source and the reconciliation path can be tested deterministically.
The change is confined to Devices-page polling and a small reconciliation helper.
Pure state tests cover updates, local grace, and node recreation; a live PipeWire check remains.
Polling is active only while the page is mapped and preserves existing row widgets.
The repository was updated in the past day and has current releases/issues.
The fix applies to all PipeWire sinks and sources controlled externally.
The reconciliation pattern covers volume and mute from hardware buttons, GNOME controls, and other clients.
The focused helper can support future device-state fields but this repair stays scoped.

ranking.deliveryNote: Readiness is an evidence-based human assessment, not a calibrated probability. Unknown inputs are never scored as facts.
